# Test promptfoo plugin integration through dynamic plugin discovery.

pe promptfoo --help
stdout 'promptfoo \[command\]'
stdout 'Import a Promptfoo configuration file'
stdout 'Export a PE configuration to Promptfoo format'

# Import a promptfoo-style config into the PE compatibility shape.
pe promptfoo import promptfoo-config.yaml -o imported-pe.yaml
exists imported-pe.yaml
grep 'version: "1.0"' imported-pe.yaml
grep 'name: openai' imported-pe.yaml
grep 'model: gpt-4o-mini' imported-pe.yaml
grep 'llm-rubric' imported-pe.yaml

# Export a PE-style config back to promptfoo-friendly keys.
pe promptfoo export pe-config.yaml -o exported-promptfoo.yaml
exists exported-promptfoo.yaml
grep 'apiProvider: openai' exported-promptfoo.yaml
grep 'temperature: 0.2' exported-promptfoo.yaml
grep 'vars:' exported-promptfoo.yaml
grep 'not-contains' exported-promptfoo.yaml

# Conversions should honor direction and infer JSON from the output extension.
pe promptfoo convert pe-config.yaml converted-promptfoo.json --direction pe-to-promptfoo
exists converted-promptfoo.json
grep '"defaultTest"' converted-promptfoo.json
grep '"not-contains"' converted-promptfoo.json
grep '"apiProvider": "openai"' converted-promptfoo.json

pe promptfoo convert promptfoo-config.yaml converted-pe.yaml
exists converted-pe.yaml
grep 'defaultTest:' converted-pe.yaml
grep 'name: openai' converted-pe.yaml

-- promptfoo-config.yaml --
description: "Promptfoo source config"
prompts:
  - "Answer {{question}}"
providers:
  - id: gpt4-mini
    apiProvider: openai
    model: gpt-4o-mini
    temperature: 0.1
  - anthropic:claude-3-haiku
defaultTest:
  assert:
    - type: not-contains
      value: "error"
tests:
  - vars:
      question: "What is 2+2?"
    assert:
      - type: llm-rubric
        value: "Says 4"

-- pe-config.yaml --
description: "PE source config"
prompts:
  - "Summarize {{topic}}"
providers:
  - id: prod
    name: openai
    config:
      model: gpt-4o-mini
      temperature: 0.2
  - anthropic:claude-3-haiku
default_test:
  assertions:
    - type: not_contains
      value: "error"
tests:
  - variables:
      topic: "Go"
    assertions:
      - type: llm_rubric
        value: "Mentions channels"
